item.starfall.aurelion_spawn_egg: Aurelion, the Fallen Warden Spawn Egg
lore.starfall.whisper.0: Before the Starfall, these woods were only trees. Now every root remembers the light.
lore.starfall.whisper.1: The Matriarch was no monster once. She wrapped the fallen shard in her roots to keep it from the dark.
lore.starfall.whisper.2: Lumistags follow the glow of the shard. Their antlers still shine with borrowed starlight.
lore.starfall.whisper.3: Do not sleep beneath the glowcaps. They dream aloud, and the dreams are hungry.
lore.starfall.whisper.4: Mosslings are the forest's apology: small, patient, and kind to those who offer fruit.
lore.starfall.whisper.5: A mother guards what she loves. A mother also bites when you come too close.
lore.starfall.whisper.6: Thorns for the greedy, sap for the grieving. Which will she give you?
lore.starfall.whisper.7: The forest hums in three notes. The fourth is missing: it fell with the star.
lore.starfall.sky.0: Once, islands drifted here on the breath of the Star. Now they drift on habit.
lore.starfall.sky.1: The Sovereign hoarded the storms to keep the sky from falling. He forgot why he started.
lore.starfall.sky.2: Cloud puffs sing only when no one listens. Be very quiet.
lore.starfall.sky.3: Skystone remembers wind. Strike it and it hums.
lore.starfall.sky.4: Those who wear aerite fall like feathers. Those who do not learn quickly.
lore.starfall.sky.5: He answers every thunderclap with one of his own. Do not shout at a god of storms.
lore.starfall.sky.6: The wind staff was carved from his first feather. He never noticed it was gone.
lore.starfall.sky.7: Above the highest cloud, the Warden once looked down. Perhaps he still does.
lore.starfall.umbral.0: The Gloom King's court fell silent the night the Star cracked. Then the silence began to rule.
lore.starfall.umbral.1: Darkness here is not an absence. It is a presence with patience.
lore.starfall.umbral.2: Crawlers weave their webs from shadows the king no longer needs.
lore.starfall.umbral.3: He drinks the souls of the brave to remember what courage felt like.
lore.starfall.umbral.4: Umbral crystal glows because it is hurt. Do not mistake pain for light.
lore.starfall.umbral.5: Wear umbral armor and the dark will stop hiding from you.
lore.starfall.umbral.6: The king's crown holds a shard. His heart holds only hunger.
lore.starfall.umbral.7: Beyond the three realms, the Warden waits, half star, half sorrow.
npc.starfall.0: Ah, a traveler! I am the Lorekeeper. Long ago a Star watched over this world, until it shattered into three shards that fell into three realms. Take these Rift Gates: place one, step through, and find the Verdant Shard in the Whisperwood. Show it to me.
npc.starfall.1: The Whisperwood awaits. Find its altar of thorns, craft a Thorn Sigil and face the Matriarch. Bring me the Verdant Shard (hold it in your hand).
npc.starfall.1b: The Verdant Shard! It still sings. Here, gates to Skyreach, where the Storm Sovereign hoards the second shard.
npc.starfall.2: Skyreach floats above the clouds. Craft a Storm Sigil from aerite and wake the Sovereign. Show me the Tempest Shard.
npc.starfall.2b: The Tempest Shard... the wind remembers you. One more waits in the dark: the Umbral Reach. Take these gates.
npc.starfall.3: In the Umbral Reach the Gloom King sits upon the last shard. Bring a Gloom Sigil and enough light to see.
npc.starfall.3b: Three shards! Combine them with a Nether Star and the Starheart will beat again. But beware: it will call Aurelion, the fallen Warden.
npc.starfall.4: Forge the Starheart, use it on open ground, and face Aurelion. Bring me the Star Fragment he leaves behind.
npc.starfall.4b: You freed him. The Star is whole in spirit, if not in stone. Take this medal and these diamonds: you are the Warden of the Realms now.
npc.starfall.5: The realms are at peace, hero. Explore the ruins, read the tablets, tame a mossling. The stars remember you.
npc.starfall.tablets: You have been reading the tablets! A scholar after my own heart. Take these as thanks.
message.starfall.boss_exists: The guardian is already awake nearby!
message.starfall.gate.whisperwood: The rift opens... mist and murmurs.
message.starfall.gate.skyreach: The rift opens... the world drops away.
message.starfall.gate.umbral: The rift opens... the light forgets you.
